Group message bubbles and place Content and Reactions inside each Root. Use align on Root to position a bubble.

## Usage

```ts
import { bubble, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/bubble';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/bubble`. It [registers](../../registration/) 4 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

| `aria-label` | `null \| string` |  |

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.

Namespace type exports `components.BubbleReactionsAlign`, `components.BubbleReactionsSide`, `components.BubbleVariant`.

- `components.bubbleReactionsVariants` takes options `side`, `align` and optional additional classes, and returns a CSS class string.

- `components.bubbleVariants` takes options `variant` and optional additional classes, and returns a CSS class string.
